title: Summarization: LLM
description:
A processing component that analyzes document content to extract concise 
summaries, key points, and named entities. Designed to enhance understanding 
and downstream utility, it supports unstructured text and delivers structured 
insights for indexing, search, or display. Ideal for distilling key information 
from large volumes of content.

llm.description: LLM to use to summarize the document
